protocol.build: default cargo release, default crate features; system libopus runtime dispatch
protocol.qualification: 120 official geometries plus 12 real geometries; range check where API available; opus_compare pass one official reference, or native same-output-channel 48k reference for real (mono duplicated into stereo reference format). Initial stereo reference rejected native mono music; corrected before timing all real mono cases uniformly. Only passing cases timed. Compare real PCM against both phase inversion options as with the official references; the additional reference is native with opposite-to-default phase inversion control.

host: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, Linux x86-64

libopus.cpu_dispatch: Unmodified distribution library with CPUID and AVX/FMA instructions present; actual selected individual decoder kernels not dynamically traced. No scalar-forcing options or rebuild.

opus-rs.output: f32 normalized PCM, round and saturate to i16 in timed adapter with reusable per-thread float scratch

opurs.output: OpusDecoder::decode public native i16 API; returns samples per channel, converted to total samples

rusty-opus.cpu_dispatch: runtime default (no ISA cap or research toggles)
rusty-opus.output: F32 native decode, convert round*32768 and saturating cast to i16 in timed path. Shared reusable thread-local PCM float scratch; does not add to per-decoder retained memory.

opus-pure.pcm_api: decode_s16, returns samples per channel; adapter multiplies by channels

ruopus.pcm_api: decode_packet_i16 allocates Vec; adapter copies to caller slice

ropus.pcm_api: public low-level OpusDecoder::decode directly to caller i16 slice; returns samples per channel

qualification_corrections.reason: Native stereo output was not a valid mono music reference; use native same-channel direct PCM at 48 kHz with both phase inversion settings, retaining official references unchanged.
